text:
jordan: Heads up — ShadeWay dedicated switchover target: Tue 2026-03-31 22:00 UTC. We plan to pin the model to `rwd-models/v2.3.1` on their slice and flip traffic. Need final ops + security ack and a rollback threshold.

sam: Acked for infra side. Confirming reserved GPU pool is primed and autoscale off during window.

lina: Security: KMS rotation scheduled for Wed 04/01 01:00 UTC; we must not rotate keys until 60m after cutover. Can we postpone rotation?

jordan: Yes — schedule rotation for +2h after cutover. We'll add a hard hold in the runbook.

ash: What are rollback criteria? Suggest: >3% error rate or p99 latency >2s sustained for 5m triggers rollback. Also watch token-cost variance >15%.

matt: +1 to ash's thresholds. Add synthetic prompt-run sanity check pre/post traffic shift.

kevin: Deploybot dry-run completed earlier: `deploybot dryrun shadeway v2.3.1 --slice slice-7` returned no schema mismatches. Logs: ``[INFO] model load OK; KV cache warmup success; endpoint health: 200``

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: shadeway-dedicated → slice-7 at 2026-03-31T22:00:00Z. Command ID: db-98765. Links: https://deploys.internal/db-98765

sre-bot: Canary telemetry snapshot (pre-cutover): p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=250ms errors=0.12% cpu=62% gpu_mem=72%

sam: Ops checklist (short):
• Confirm backup snapshot of slice config at -1h
• Disable autoscale + set max replicas=0 for burst 
• Pin model to `rwd-models/v2.3.1` at T-5m
• Run synthetic checks T+1m and T+10m
• Rollback if thresholds hit

lina: Security checklist:
• KMS rotation hold in runbook ✅
• Audit logging enabled for slice ✅
• Encryption-at-rest validated ✅

jordan: Can I get explicit thumbs from infra, sec, and SRE? Need green to click deploy.

sam: :thumbsup: infra ready.

lina: :white_check_mark: security ready.

ash: SRE will monitor from ops room. :thumbsup:

matt: Holding a 30m pre-window readiness call 21:30 UTC — ping me if anything blocks.

kevin: One more note — model rollback image available as `rwd-models/v2.3.0-stable`, automatic fallback configured in routing policy if health check fails.

jordan: Perfect. Final: I'll hit the scheduled deploy at 22:00 unless anyone raises a blocker in the next 30m.

deploybot: Reminder: scheduled deploy in 15m (2026-03-31T21:45:00Z) — db-98765. To cancel: `deploybot cancel db-98765`

sam: No blockers from infra.

lina: No security blockers.

ash: Monitoring playbook loaded in ops room.

deploybot: Executing deploy db-98765 now. Rolling pin: `rwd-models/v2.3.1` -> slice-7. Steps: snapshot -> pin -> traffic-shift (10% -> 50% -> 100%) -> post-checks.

sre-bot: Post-check T+1m: p50=48ms p95=130ms p99=260ms errors=0.18% (within thresholds).

matt: T+10m status: traffic at 100%, metrics stable.

jordan: ShadeWay switchover complete. Thanks all. Leaving notes for audit and follow-up: schedule KMS rotation at 01:00 UTC +2h hold confirmed.

kevin: Marking release notes: "ShadeWay — dedicated slice pinned to v2.3.1; rollback image v2.3.0-stable available; KMS rotation delayed +2h."

lina: I'll close the security checklist and file audit entry.

ash: Ops debrief in #eng-oncall tomorrow 09:00 PT.

sam: :rocket:
